title: Protocol for the Maintenance of Quiescent Murine Hematopoietic Stem Cells
protocol: Euthanize the mouse by cervical dislocation.
Sterilize the dissection area, dissection kit, and the fur of the mouse with 70% ethanol.
Cut the skin of the abdomen and strip off the skin to the ankles.
Cut off the foot from the tibia just above the ankle and strip off the triceps surae along with the Achilles tendon.
Cut the patellar tendon, remove the quadriceps femoris and the biceps femoris muscles from the femur, and dislocate the hind limb from the hip joint.
Dislocate femurs and tibiae at the patella.
Remove residual muscles and connective tissues entirely using scissors (on paper towel).
Place the bones in 20–30 mL of ice-cold PBS + 2% FCS in a 10-cm Petri dish.
Flush the femurs and tibiae with PBS + 2% FCS using a 21-gauge needle and a 10-mL syringe to collect the bone marrow plug and disperse the plug by refluxing through the needle.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 50-mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the suspension at 680 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant by inverting the tube quickly.
Remove droplets on the rim using a paper towel.
Add 5 mL of red cell lysis buffer per mouse and incubate on ice for 1 min.
Add 2 volumes of PBS + 2% FCS and centrifuge at 680 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 10–20 mL of PBS + 2% FCS.
Filter the cell suspension through a 40-μm nylon mesh.
Centrifuge at 680 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 80 μL/mouse PBS + 2% FCS.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 1.5-mL tube.
Add an anti-CD16/32 antibody to block Fc-receptor (2 μL/mouse) and incubate for 5 min at 4°C.
Add anti-c-Kit magnetic beads at a 1/5 v/v ratio and incubate for 15 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 0.5 to 1 mL of PBS + 2% FCS and centrifuge at 680 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Repeat step with rinsing the 1.5-mL tube with another 1 mL of PBS + 2%FCS.
Resuspend cells in 1 mL of PBS + 2% FCS and filter the suspension with a 40-μm filter.
Transfer to a 5-mL tube.
Rinse the 1.5-mL tube with another 1 mL of PBS + 2%FCS, and transfer to the 5-mL tube.
Enrich c-Kit-positive cells using Auto-MACS Pro and the Possel-S program.
Transfer the cell suspension of the positive fraction into two 1.5-mL tubes separately.
Centrifuge at 340 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Label cells with lineage markers (CD4, CD8a, Gr-1, Mac-1, Ter-119, B220) at 0.5 μL per mouse using PerCP-Cy5.5.
Label cells with c-Kit antibody at 0.5 μL per mouse using APC-Cy7.
Label cells with Sca-1 antibody at 0.5 μL per mouse using PE-Cy7.
Label cells with CD150 antibody at 0.5 μL per mouse using PE.
Label cells with Flt3 antibody at 0.5 μL per mouse using APC.
Label cells with CD48 antibody at 0.5 μL per mouse using FITC.
Mix all antibodies with 20 μL of PBS + 2% FCS.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the antibody cocktail and combine into one tube.
Incubate cells for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 1 mL of PBS + 2% FCS to the sample.
Centrifuge the sample at 340 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant from the centrifuged sample.
Resuspend cells in 0.5–2 mL of PBS + 2% FCS + 0.1% propidium iodide.
Filter the suspension with a 40-μm filter.
Transfer the filtered suspension to a 5-mL tube.
Split bone marrow cells to the number of colors + 1 and dispense them into 1.5-mL tubes.
Label each compensation sample with 1 μL of fluorochrome-conjugated anti-CD45 antibodies for 30 min at 4°C.
Add 1 mL of PBS + 2% FCS to each labeled compensation sample.
Centrifuge the samples at 340 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant from each sample.
Resuspend cells in 0.5 mL of PBS + 2% FCS.
Filter the cell suspension with a 40-μm filter.
Transfer the filtered suspension to a 5-mL tube.
Perform fluorescent compensation for the flow cytometer being used.
Sort HSCs with marker phenotype CD150+CD41-CD48-Flt3-CD34- LSK or CD150+CD48-Flt3-EPCR+ LSK using the FACS AriaIIIu in a 1.5-mL tube containing 500 μL of culture media with 4% w/v BSA.
Centrifuge sorted cells at 340 × g for 5 min at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant to avoid disturbing the pellet.
Keep the cell pellet on ice until culture.
Transfer 200 μL of the medium into each well of a 96-well round-bottom plate.
Fill unused wells with 100–200 μL of PBS to prevent evaporation.
Resuspend sorted HSCs in the culture medium at 30–100 cells/μL.
Add 10 μL of the HSC suspension to each well (containing 300–1,000 cells per well).
Place the culture plate in a humidified multi-gas incubator at 37°C under 1% O2 and 5% CO2 conditions.
Use a flat-bottom tissue culture plate for HSC maintenance.
Sort HSCs directly into the culture well using single-cell sorting mode on FACS Aria or other sorters.
Dispense HSCs using an 8-channel pipet to reduce variation in cell counts.
Replace half of the medium every 3 to 4 days for long-term cultures (>7 days).
Aspirate 100 μL of medium carefully without disrupting the colony.
Add 100 μL of pre-warmed fresh medium gently to each well.
